activity_summary: You had them bow, in advance, to a chair you would not name. Heminges had the boy's four lines and no fifth. The king is to be whole, on their floor, and the three leaves are not to be spoken in the yard. They have not been spoken since June. Nine players and two boys. Twelve at table. By water at five. Kemp is not among them. Nick keeps Saturday's note, lower for the panelling. Arthur keeps the Duchess. The glass is not rehearsed here. The purse is not guessed. Egeon is at two, and Gaunt is after, and the rolls are not to be mixed.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused the name, the yard, and a new part for Kemp.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Gave the bow, the nine, the two, and the twelve.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Reported the four lines, and would not guess the purse or the cart.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Accepted the leaves after dark, and kept the two words in the orchard.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Kept Nick to Saturday's note, and did not swap the boys.

entities.context: Said he would go lower for the panelling, and not from fear.

facets.activity: Had them bow to the chair by the fire

quotes.speaker: george_bryan
quotes.text: Bow to the chair by the fire, whoever is in it.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Item, the boy came. Four lines. Tuesday, Canon Row, by water at five, the king whole.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Not in this yard. Tonight, on their floor, and then back into the chest.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Kemp is not among the nine. He has no part in this king.

quotes.speaker: augustine_phillips
quotes.text: The note Nick has is the note he keeps.
